latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — generate music videos synced to your audio and images, ready for download.

- Upload your audio (MP3/WAV) and images (JPG/PNG, up to 500MB) and describe the music video you want.
- Automatic backend connection and auth with free credits if needed; shows connection status.
- Generates 1080p MP4 videos synced to the beat, with smooth transitions.
- Session-based workflow: upload, edit, preview, and export, all tracked in your session.
- Error handling for token issues, file size, unsupported formats, credits, and rate limits.
- Clean, user-friendly prompts with technical steps handled in the background.
